usageNotes: Rolls back a remote LXC container to a named snapshot, reverting both disk and configuration to the snapshot state — all changes made after the snapshot was taken are permanently lost. The container must be stopped before rollback (unless `start` is set, which will start it after a successful rollback). Returns a remote UPID; poll that UPID for task completion before assuming the rollback is done. Requires `Resource.Manage` on the remote guest.

examples.summary: Roll back LXC 201 on remote 'hetzner-pve' to snapshot 'pre-upgrade' and start it afterward

destructiveReason: All disk data and configuration changes made after the snapshot was taken are permanently discarded and cannot be recovered.
tips: Stop the container before initiating rollback; a running container will cause the operation to fail on most storage backends.
Use `start: true` to atomically start the container after rollback rather than issuing a separate start call.
The returned UPID is scoped to the remote node — use the appropriate remote task-status endpoint to poll it, not the local PDM task API.
Snapshot names are case-sensitive and follow the pattern [A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]*; verify the exact name via the snapshot list endpoint before calling rollback.
If the container uses linked clones or external volumes not covered by the snapshot, those volumes are NOT rolled back.
